findings.reader: A well-scoped, well-bounded dated news piece: it explains the sketch/comment mechanism causally, keeps vendor claims attributed and limited, grounds consequences in specific reader situations, and closes with a proportionate testable action. All failure families are clear; explain-back and an invented transfer scenario both succeed.
findings.facts: Factually clean: release date, features, availability, limits, performance and hands-on claims all match their designated source excerpts with attribution and limitations intact. Vendor claims are labelled as such and the Axios test is correctly bounded as a small task set, so integrity, freshness, dated-change and uncertainty handling all pass.
